title.zh: 卷379 列傳一百六十六 赵慎畛 卢坤 曾胜 陶澍
title.en: Volume 379 Biographies 166: Zhao Shenzhen, Lu Kun, Ceng Sheng, Tao Shu
title.raw: 卷379 列傳一百六十六 赵慎畛 卢坤 曾胜 陶澍

sentences.zh: 列傳一百六十六

translations.literal: Biographies 166
translations.idiomatic: Biography 166

sentences.zh: 趙慎畛盧坤曾勝陶澍

translations.literal: Zhao Shenzhen, Lu Kun, Ceng Sheng, Tao Shu
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shenzhen, Lu Kun, Ceng Sheng, and Tao Shu

sentences.zh: 趙慎畛，字笛樓，湖南武陵人。

translations.literal: Zhao Shenzhen, style name Dilou, was a man of Wuling in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shenzhen, whose courtesy name was Dilou, came from Wuling in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 為諸生時，學政錢灃器之，曰：「人英也！

translations.literal: When he was a licentiate student, the education intendant Qian Feng valued him and said: "A paragon among men!"
translations.idiomatic: While still a degree candidate, the provincial education commissioner Qian Feng took notice of him and exclaimed, "Here is a remarkable man!"

sentences.zh: 」嘉慶元年，成進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the first year of the Jiaqing reign he passed the metropolitan examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In 1796 he passed the jinshi examination, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and received appointment as a compiler.

sentences.zh: 遷御史、給事中。

translations.literal: He was transferred to censor and supervising secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to the posts of censor and supervising secretary.

sentences.zh: 條上川、楚善後屯田保甲事宜。

translations.literal: He submitted in itemized form plans for post-rebellion settlement regarding military colonies and community self-defense in Sichuan and Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: He laid out in detail proposals for organizing military colonies and local militia in the aftermath of the Sichuan and Hubei pacification.

sentences.zh: 巡通州漕，革陋規，廉得楊村通判科索剝船，奏褫其職。

translations.literal: Inspecting the grain transport at Tongzhou, he abolished corrupt practices; through an investigation he found that the subprefect of Yangcun extorted and stripped transport boats, and he memorialized for his dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: While inspecting the Grand Canal grain transport at Tongzhou, he eliminated entrenched abuses, uncovered evidence that the Yangcun subprefect had been extorting transport crews, and memorialized for his removal from office.

sentences.zh: 湖南學政徐松矜愎失士心，欲附慎畛自固，常列其弟子優等，慎畛列款糾劾罷之。

translations.literal: Xu Song, Hunan's education intendant, was arrogant and willful and had lost the confidence of scholars; wishing to attach himself to Shenzhe to strengthen his position, he often listed his own disciples in the top grade; Shenzhe set forth the facts in a memorial impeaching him and had him removed.
translations.idiomatic: The Hunan education commissioner Xu Song was arrogant and high-handed and had alienated the scholarly community; hoping to secure himself by currying favor with Zhao Shenzhen, he habitually ranked his own students at the top of examinations; Zhao listed his offenses in a memorial and had him dismissed.

sentences.zh: 兩廣總督蔣攸銛薦其才可大用。

translations.literal: The governor-general of Guangdong and Guangxi Jiang Yihuai recommended that his talent could be put to great use.
translations.idiomatic: The governor-general of the Two Guang, Jiang Yihuai, recommended him as a man of outstanding ability fit for high responsibility.

sentences.zh: 十七年，出為廣東惠潮嘉道。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he went out as intendant of the Huizhou-Chaozhou-Jiaying circuit in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In 1812 he was appointed intendant of the Huizhou-Chaozhou-Jiaying circuit in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 嚴治械鬥，捕南澳、澄海、潮陽盜甚眾；

translations.literal: He strictly suppressed armed clan fights and captured a great many bandits in Nan'ao, Chenghai, and Chaoyang;
translations.idiomatic: He cracked down hard on armed clan feuds and captured large numbers of bandits in Nan'ao, Chenghai, and Chaoyang;

sentences.zh: 沿海民寮居為逋逃藪，悉編入保甲。

translations.literal: along the coast the Miao settlements had become haunts for fugitives, and he enrolled them all in the community self-defense system.
translations.idiomatic: along the coast, minority settlements that had become refuges for fugitives were all enrolled in the local militia system.

sentences.zh: 逾年，擢廣西按察使。

translations.literal: After more than a year he was promoted to judicial commissioner of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: A year later he was promoted to judicial commissioner of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 天地會匪結黨構亂，脅有貲者入其中，慎畛惟嚴罪匪首，被脅者不坐。

translations.literal: Tiandihui bandits formed factions and stirred up disorder, coercing the wealthy to join them; Shenzhe punished only the ringleaders strictly, and those who had been coerced were not prosecuted.
translations.idiomatic: When Tiandihui rebels formed factions and stirred up trouble, coercing wealthy men to join them, Zhao punished only the ringleaders severely while exempting those who had been forced to participate.

sentences.zh: 廣東洋匪投誠後，漸入廣西為盜。

translations.literal: After Guangdong's foreign pirates had surrendered, they gradually entered Guangxi as bandits.
translations.idiomatic: After coastal pirates in Guangdong had surrendered, they gradually drifted into Guangxi to continue raiding as bandits.

sentences.zh: 設水路巡船以護商旅，督守令以捕盜多少為殿最。

translations.literal: He established patrol boats on the waterways to protect merchants and travelers, and supervised prefects and magistrates with the number of bandits captured as the criterion for ranking their performance.
translations.idiomatic: He established water patrols to protect merchants and travelers and ranked prefects and magistrates according to how many bandits they captured.

sentences.zh: 遠郡招解重囚煩費，吏因諱盜，省文法，嚴舉劾，緝捕始力。

translations.literal: In distant prefectures escorting major prisoners for trial was costly and troublesome, so officials concealed crimes; he simplified legal procedures, strictly impeached offenders, and only then did pursuit and capture become vigorous.
translations.idiomatic: In remote prefectures the cost of escorting major prisoners for trial led officials to conceal crimes; he streamlined legal procedures, imposed strict accountability, and only then did enforcement become effective.

sentences.zh: 二十年，遷廣東布政使。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was transferred to be provincial treasurer of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In 1815 he was transferred to the post of provincial treasurer of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 州縣多積虧，展轉相承，悉心鉤稽，除其糾轕，庫儲頓增。

translations.literal: Prefectures and counties had accumulated many deficits passed on from one to another; he painstakingly audited accounts, cleared the entanglements, and treasury reserves suddenly increased.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties had long carried forward accumulated deficits; through painstaking audits he untangled the accounts and treasury reserves rose sharply.

sentences.zh: 南海、高要瀕河堤防多圮，民苦水患，籌款生息資歲修，屯田五千餘頃。

translations.literal: In Nanhai and Gaoyao the river-bank dikes were largely ruined and the people suffered from flooding; he raised funds to generate interest for annual repairs and had more than five thousand qing of military colony land.
translations.idiomatic: In Nanhai and Gaoyao, river dikes along the banks were largely in ruins and the people suffered from floods; he set aside capital to generate interest for annual repairs and administered more than five thousand qing of military colony land.

sentences.zh: 賦重為累，請減糧額，攤抵於沙坦輕則之地。

translations.literal: Heavy taxation had become a burden; he requested reduction of the grain quota and apportionment of the offset onto sandy flats taxed at lighter rates.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy tax assessments had become a burden; he petitioned to reduce the grain quota and spread the reduction onto sandy flats subject to lighter taxation.

sentences.zh: 粵俗奢靡，刊發陳宏謀行政訓俗遺規，躬行節儉以示勸。

translations.literal: Guangdong custom was extravagant; he published Chen Hongmou's Administrative Instructions and Remaining Regulations for Moral Instruction and personally practiced frugality to set an example.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong society was given to extravagance; he published Chen Hongmou's surviving regulations on governance and moral instruction and personally practiced frugality to encourage others.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，擢廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was promoted to governor of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In 1818 he was promoted to governor of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 習知粵西地勢如建瓴，旬日不雨即旱竭，勸民修隄塘，造龍骨車，開廕井，設井筒架，皆頒式俾仿行。

translations.literal: Knowing well that western Guangdong's terrain was like a jar tilted on its side—if ten days passed without rain drought would set in—he urged the people to repair dikes and ponds, build chain pumps, dig shaded wells, and set up well-tower frames, all with models issued for imitation.
translations.idiomatic: Well aware that western Guangdong's terrain made water scarce within days without rain, he urged the people to repair dikes and ponds, build chain pumps, dig shaded wells, and erect well-tower frames, issuing standard designs for all to follow.

sentences.zh: 地連黔、楚，群盜出沒，宜山會匪廖五桂、藍耀青分踞新、舊兩墟，糾眾分黨，偽立名目，勒索殷戶，爭利相擾，親往捕誅之。

translations.literal: The region bordered Guizhou and Hubei and bandits came and went in groups; at Yishan the Tiandihui bandits Liao Wugui and Lan Yaoqing held the new and old market towns separately, mustered crowds and divided into factions, falsely established titles, extorted wealthy households, and fought over profits disturbing one another; he went in person to capture and execute them.
translations.idiomatic: Bordering Guizhou and Hubei, the region was plagued by roaming bandits; at Yishan, Tiandihui rebels Liao Wugui and Lan Yaoqing held the new and old market towns, mustered followers into factions, set up bogus titles, and extorted wealthy households until their rivalries disrupted the district; Zhao went in person to capture and execute them.

sentences.zh: 飭屬行保甲，置望樓，練民壯互相守望，縣建卡房數十座，府各督屬會營巡緝。

translations.literal: He ordered subordinates to implement the community self-defense system, set up watch towers, trained local militia to keep watch for one another, had counties build dozens of checkpoint stations, and had each prefecture supervise its subordinates to join with garrison troops in patrol and pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered his subordinates to enforce the militia system, erected watchtowers, trained local militia for mutual defense, had counties build dozens of checkpoint stations, and had each prefecture coordinate with garrison troops on patrols.

sentences.zh: 柳州至省千餘裡，設水汛四十三所，終任凡獲盜千七百餘人。

translations.literal: From Liuzhou to the provincial capital was more than a thousand li; he established forty-three water patrol posts, and throughout his term captured more than seventeen hundred bandits in all.
translations.idiomatic: Along the thousand-odd li from Liuzhou to the provincial capital he established forty-three water patrol posts, and over his entire term captured more than seventeen hundred bandits.

sentences.zh: 盜多出於流匪，編客民籍，驅其單身遊蕩者，礦廠窯榨傭丁皆立冊，有保者留，否則逐。

translations.literal: Most bandits came from drifting ruffians; he registered migrant populations, expelled those who wandered alone, and had all hired laborers at mines, kilns, and presses enrolled in registers—those with guarantors could stay, otherwise they were expelled.
translations.idiomatic: Most bandits were drifting ruffians; he registered migrant populations, expelled unattached wanderers, and required all hired labor at mines, kilns, and presses to be registered—those with guarantors could remain, others were expelled.

sentences.zh: 故事，梧、潯二關，巡撫例得動用盈餘。

translations.literal: By precedent, at the Wuzhou and Xunzhou customs passes the governor was permitted to use the surplus revenue.
translations.idiomatic: By established practice, the governor was entitled to use surplus revenue from the Wuzhou and Xunzhou customs posts.

sentences.zh: 慎畛曰：「吾家衣食粗足，身為大臣，取盈將安用之？

translations.literal: Shenzhe said: "My family's food and clothing are roughly sufficient; as a high minister, what use would I have for taking surplus?"
translations.idiomatic: Zhao said, "My family's needs are modestly met; as a senior minister, what use would I have for surplus funds?"

sentences.zh: 當為國家布仁澤耳。

translations.literal: One ought to spread benevolent grace for the state.
translations.idiomatic: They should be used to spread the state's benevolence to the people.

sentences.zh: 」乃於桂林設預備倉，增設書院，柳州、慶遠、思恩三府皆創設之；

translations.literal: Thereupon at Guilin he established a reserve granary, added academies, and founded them in the three prefectures of Liuzhou, Qingyuan, and Si'en as well;
translations.idiomatic: He then established a reserve granary at Guilin, expanded the academy there, and founded new academies in the prefectures of Liuzhou, Qingyuan, and Si'en;

sentences.zh: 繕城濬河，廣置棲流所，並取給焉。

translations.literal: repaired city walls and dredged rivers, widely set up shelters for vagrants, and drew on these funds for all of it.
translations.idiomatic: repaired city walls, dredged rivers, and greatly expanded shelters for the destitute, funding all of it from this surplus.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，入覲，宣宗嘉其誠實不欺，溫諭褒勉，擢閩浙總督。

translations.literal: In the second year of the Daoguang reign he came to court for an audience; the Xuanzong Emperor praised his honesty without deceit, warmly instructed and commended him, and promoted him to governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1822 he presented himself at court; the Daoguang Emperor praised his scrupulous honesty, warmly commended him, and promoted him to governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 嚴申軍律，課諸鎮營汛勤訓練。

translations.literal: He strictly proclaimed military discipline and required all garrison brigades and outposts to train diligently.
translations.idiomatic: He strictly enforced military discipline and required all garrison units and outposts to train diligently.

sentences.zh: 浙江提督沈添華玩縱，劾罷之。

translations.literal: The Zhejiang provincial military commander Shen Tianhua was negligent and indulgent; he impeached and dismissed him.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhejiang provincial military commander Shen Tianhua was negligent and lax; Zhao impeached him and had him removed.

sentences.zh: 責水師緝海盜，盜多就擒。

translations.literal: He charged the naval forces to pursue sea pirates, and most of the pirates were captured.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the naval forces to pursue pirates at sea, and most were captured.

sentences.zh: 上游四府多山，客民租山立廠，遊匪群聚，遣兵搜山，捕誅其魁。

translations.literal: The four upstream prefectures were mostly mountainous; migrant tenants rented mountains and set up works, and roaming ruffians gathered in groups; he sent troops to search the mountains and captured and executed their leaders.
translations.idiomatic: The four upstream prefectures were mountainous; migrant tenants rented hillsides for timber operations where roaming ruffians gathered; he sent troops to search the mountains and captured and executed the ringleaders.

sentences.zh: 閩安所轄有瑯琦島，居民多為奸利，擒治之，移駐水師，建砲台，遂為省城門戶。

translations.literal: Under Min'an jurisdiction was Langqi Island, whose inhabitants mostly pursued illicit profit; he captured and punished them, moved the naval garrison there, built batteries, and it thus became the gateway to the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: Langqi Island under Min'an jurisdiction was home to residents who pursued illicit profits; he arrested and punished them, relocated the naval garrison there, built batteries, and thereby secured the gateway to the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 台灣自來多亂，動煩大兵，慎畛尤以為慮，盡選賢能以治。

translations.literal: Taiwan had always been prone to disorder and frequently required large forces; Shenzhe was especially concerned about this and selected worthy and able men throughout to govern it.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan had long been prone to unrest and often required large military expeditions; Zhao was especially concerned about this and appointed capable men throughout to govern it.

sentences.zh: 鳳山莠民楊良斌煽眾起事，檄巡道孔昭虔、知府孔傳穟剿治，未一月而定，不煩一兵渡海。

translations.literal: The vicious commoner of Fengshan Yang Liangbin incited the masses to rise; he issued orders to the circuit intendant Kong Zhaoqian and prefect Kong Chuansui to suppress and settle it; within less than a month it was pacified without troubling a single soldier to cross the sea.
translations.idiomatic: When the Fengshan troublemaker Yang Liangbin incited a popular uprising, Zhao dispatched orders to circuit intendant Kong Zhaoqian and prefect Kong Chuansui to suppress it; within a month the disturbance was settled without sending a single soldier across the strait.

sentences.zh: 驩瑪蘭初設治，部議賦則較重，奏減之。

translations.literal: Huanmala had only recently been placed under administration; the ministry deliberated that the tax assessment was rather heavy, and he memorialized to reduce it.
translations.idiomatic: When Huanmala was first placed under administration, the ministry's proposed tax assessment was heavy; he memorialized for a reduction.

sentences.zh: 民入山伐木，歲供道廠船料，匠首苛斂激變，捕誅首亂，更定採木章程，乃相安。

translations.literal: The people entered the mountains to cut timber, annually supplying ship timber for the transport works; the master craftsmen extorted harshly and provoked disturbances; he captured and executed the ringleaders of the disorder, revised the regulations for timber cutting, and only then was there peace.
translations.idiomatic: When the people went into the mountains to cut timber for annual shipbuilding supplies, the head craftsmen's harsh exactions provoked disturbances; he captured and executed the ringleaders, revised the timber-cutting regulations, and order was restored.

sentences.zh: 戍兵萬四千，更代時皆赴廈門，由提督點驗，遠者千里，改由各提鎮分驗，兵困以蘇。

translations.literal: There were fourteen thousand garrison troops; at rotation all went to Xiamen for inspection by the provincial commander, and for those far away it was a thousand li; he changed it so each provincial commander and brigade commander inspected separately, and the soldiers' hardship was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen thousand garrison troops had to travel to Xiamen for inspection by the provincial commander at rotation—some from a thousand li away; he changed the system so each garrison commander inspected locally, greatly easing the soldiers' burden.

sentences.zh: 台灣產米，漳、泉數郡仰給商運，江、浙、天津民無蓋藏，米貴輒生亂，於海口稽米船出數，酌豐歉為限制，常留有餘。

translations.literal: Taiwan produced rice; several prefectures of Zhangzhou and Quanzhou relied on merchant transport for supply; in Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Tianjin the people had no reserves, and when rice was dear disorder often arose; at the seaports he checked the number of rice ships departing, set limits according to abundance or scarcity, and always kept a surplus in reserve.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan produced rice on which Zhangzhou and Quanzhou depended through merchant shipping; in Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Tianjin the people kept no reserves, and high rice prices often sparked unrest; he monitored rice shipments at the ports, set export limits according to harvest conditions, and always maintained a reserve supply.

sentences.zh: 疏請漳浦明儒黃道周從祀文廟，下廷臣議行。

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting that the Ming scholar of Zhangpu Huang Daozhou be granted accompanying sacrifice in the Confucian temple; the matter was referred to court ministers for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that the Ming scholar Huang Daozhou of Zhangpu be granted posthumous worship in the Confucian temple; the court referred the matter to ministers for deliberation and approval.

sentences.zh: 侯官謝金鑾、德化鄭兼才皆以學行著，素所敬禮，歿而舉祀鄉賢。

translations.literal: Xie Jinluan of Houguan and Zheng Jiancai of Dehua were both renowned for learning and conduct, men he had always respected; after their deaths he recommended them for worship in the local worthies shrine.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Jinluan of Houguan and Zheng Jiancai of Dehua were both renowned for scholarship and character, men he had long respected; after their deaths he recommended them for worship in the local worthies shrine.

sentences.zh: 又旌表義烈，以振風俗。

translations.literal: He also bestowed commendatory tablets on the righteous and valiant to revive custom.
translations.idiomatic: He also honored the righteous and the valiant with commemorative tablets to uplift public morals.

sentences.zh: 五年，調雲貴總督。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1825 he was transferred to governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 銅礦、鹽務積疲，疏陳變通整頓之法。

translations.literal: The copper mines and salt administration had long been exhausted; he memorialized setting forth methods for flexible reform and thorough rectification.
translations.idiomatic: The copper mines and salt administration had long been in decline; he memorialized with proposals for flexible reform and thorough rectification.

sentences.zh: 以邊防莫便於屯田，方考訪形勢利便，未及議行而疾作。

translations.literal: Believing that for border defense nothing was more convenient than military colonies, he was just investigating terrain and advantages when illness struck before the plans could be implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Believing military colonies were the best means of border defense, he was surveying terrain and advantages when illness struck before his plans could be implemented.

sentences.zh: 病中拜疏劾貪黷不職者數十人。

translations.literal: While ill he presented a memorial impeaching several dozen corrupt and negligent officials.
translations.idiomatic: From his sickbed he submitted a memorial impeaching several dozen corrupt and negligent officials.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遂卒。

translations.literal: Before long he died.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he died.

sentences.zh: 代者急遞追回原疏，滇人惜之。

translations.literal: His successor urgently dispatched a courier to recall the original memorial; the people of Yunnan regretted it.
translations.idiomatic: His successor urgently recalled the memorial by courier; the people of Yunnan deeply regretted its loss.

sentences.zh: 遺疏上，優詔賜卹，贈太子少保，諡文恪，祀名宦、鄉賢祠。

translations.literal: His final memorial was submitted; an imperial edict graciously granted condolence payments, posthumously conferred Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, gave the posthumous title Wenge, and enshrined him in the shrines of eminent officials and local worthies.
translations.idiomatic: His final memorial reached the throne; the emperor graciously granted funeral honors, posthumously conferred the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, gave him the posthumous name Wenge, and ordered his worship in the shrines of eminent officials and local worthies.

sentences.zh: 慎畛服膺儒先，凡有益身心可致用者，皆身體力行。

translations.literal: Shenzhe embraced the Confucian sages of old; whatever was beneficial to mind and body and could be put to practical use, he practiced in person.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao embraced the teachings of the Confucian sages; whatever could benefit mind and character and be put to practical use, he practiced himself.

sentences.zh: 好善嫉惡，體恤屬僚，訓懇切，如師之於弟子。

translations.literal: He loved the good and hated evil, was considerate toward subordinates, and instructed them earnestly like a teacher toward disciples.
translations.idiomatic: He loved virtue and hated vice, was considerate toward his subordinates, and instructed them earnestly as a teacher would his students.

sentences.zh: 所至於文武官吏，常能識別其才否，人亦樂為之用。

translations.literal: Wherever he went, regarding civil and military officials he could usually discern whether they had talent or not, and people were also glad to serve under him.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever he served, he could usually discern the abilities of civil and military officials, and they were glad to serve under him.

sentences.zh: 所著奏議、從征錄、載年錄、讀書日記、惜日筆記等書及詩文集凡數十卷。

translations.literal: His writings included memorials, records of campaigns, chronological records, reading diaries, notes on cherishing the day, and collected poetry and prose totaling several dozen juan.
translations.idiomatic: His writings included memorials, campaign records, chronological journals, reading diaries, notes on making good use of time, and collected poetry and prose totaling several dozen volumes.

sentences.zh: 盧坤，字厚山，順天涿州人。

translations.literal: Lu Kun, style name Houshan, was a man of Zhuozhou in Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Kun, whose courtesy name was Houshan, came from Zhuozhou in Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年進士，選庶吉士，散館授兵部主事，洊遷郎中。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of the Jiaqing reign he passed the metropolitan examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and upon leaving the academy was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of War, and was repeatedly promoted to director.
translations.idiomatic: In 1799 he passed the jinshi examination, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and upon completing his academy term was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of War, rising eventually to director.

sentences.zh: 扈隨木蘭，校射，賜花翎。

translations.literal: He accompanied the emperor to Mulan, competed in archery, and was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: He accompanied the emperor on the Mulan hunt, distinguished himself in the archery competition, and was awarded the peacock feather insignia.

sentences.zh: 十八年，出為湖南糧儲道，丁本生父母憂，服闋，歷廣東惠潮嘉道、山東兗沂曹濟道、湖北按察使、甘肅布政使。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he went out as grain intendant of Hunan, mourned the death of his biological parents, and after the mourning period served successively as intendant of the Huizhou-Chaozhou-Jiaying circuit in Guangdong, the Yan-Yi-Cao-Ji circuit in Shandong, judicial commissioner of Hubei, and provincial treasurer of Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In 1813 he was appointed grain intendant of Hunan; after mourning his parents he served successively as intendant of the Huizhou-Chaozhou-Jiaying circuit in Guangdong, the Yan-Yi-Cao-Ji circuit in Shandong, judicial commissioner of Hubei, and provincial treasurer of Gansu.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，護理陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the first year of the Daoguang reign he acted as governor of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In 1821 he served as acting governor of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 二年，擢廣東巡撫，未之任，調陝西。

translations.literal: In the second year he was promoted to governor of Guangdong but did not take up the post and was transferred to Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In 1822 he was promoted to governor of Guangdong but was transferred to Shaanxi before taking up the post.

sentences.zh: 議者謂南山老林易藪姦，不宜開墾。

translations.literal: Deliberators said the old forests of the southern mountains easily harbored villains and were unsuitable for opening to cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Critics argued that the old-growth forests of the southern mountains easily sheltered bandits and should not be opened to cultivation.

sentences.zh: 坤歷陳漢、蜀、唐、宋史事，及漢李翕郙閣頌，以徵墾治之利；

translations.literal: Kun cited in succession historical events of Han, Shu, Tang, and Song, and the Han Li Xi's "Ode to the Postal Pavilion," to demonstrate the benefits of reclamation and settlement;
translations.idiomatic: Lu cited historical precedents from the Han, Shu, Tang, and Song dynasties, as well as Li Xi's Han dynasty "Ode to the Postal Pavilion," to demonstrate the benefits of land reclamation;

sentences.zh: 專任嚴如熤，假以便宜，墾務大興。

translations.literal: he entrusted Yan Ruyi exclusively and granted him discretionary authority, and reclamation work flourished greatly.
translations.idiomatic: he placed Yan Ruyi in sole charge with discretionary authority, and reclamation work flourished.

sentences.zh: 勘修南山各屬城工，漢江堤岸，築壩濬淤，審度形勢，移駐文武，增改官制。

translations.literal: He surveyed and repaired city works in the various districts of the southern mountains, the Han River dikes, built dams and dredged silt, assessed terrain, relocated civil and military officials, and added and revised the official system.
translations.idiomatic: He surveyed and repaired city fortifications in the southern mountain districts, reinforced Han River dikes, built dams and dredged silt, assessed terrain, relocated civil and military officials, and revised the administrative structure.

sentences.zh: 又修復咸寧、長安、涇陽、盩厔、岐山、寶雞、華州、榆林河渠水利，籌補榆林、綏德兩屬常平倉穀，勸民捐建社倉。

translations.literal: He also restored irrigation works at Xianning, Chang'an, Jingyang, Zhouzhi, Qishan, Baoji, Huazhou, and Yulin, planned to replenish the Ever-Normal granary grain of Yulin and Suide subordinates, and urged the people to donate and build community granaries.
translations.idiomatic: He also restored irrigation works at Xianning, Chang'an, Jingyang, Zhouzhi, Qishan, Baoji, Huazhou, and Yulin, replenished Ever-Normal granary stocks in Yulin and Suide, and encouraged the people to donate funds for community granaries.

sentences.zh: 疏陳：「察吏之要，不獨親民，官貪廉為民身家所繫，其勤​​惰、明昧、寬嚴，皆關民生休戚。

translations.literal: He memorialized stating: "The key to inspecting officials lies not only in closeness to the people; an official's corruption or integrity bears on the people's livelihood and property, and his diligence or laziness, clarity or obscurity, leniency or severity—all bear on the people's weal and woe."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "The key to evaluating officials lies not only in their closeness to the people; an official's integrity affects the people's livelihood and property, and his diligence, competence, and temperament all bear on their welfare."

sentences.zh: 」宣宗深韙之。

translations.literal: The Xuanzong Emperor deeply approved of it.
translations.idiomatic: The Daoguang Emperor strongly approved of this view.

sentences.zh: 五年，以母憂去官。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he left office on account of mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: In 1825 he left office to mourn his mother.

sentences.zh: 六年，回疆用兵，特起駐肅州，偕總督鄂山治轉餉。

translations.literal: In the sixth year troops were used in the Muslim borderlands; he was specially summoned and stationed at Suzhou, joining Governor-General Eshan in managing transport of provisions.
translations.idiomatic: In 1826, when military operations began in the Muslim borderlands, he was specially recalled and stationed at Suzhou, joining Governor-General Eshan in managing supply transport.

sentences.zh: 以托古遜為運糧首站，自烏魯木齊至阿克蘇，置三十二站，大兵五萬餘，日需糧五百石，每站備駝五百有奇，由山西、陝西採購；

translations.literal: Taking Tuoguxun as the first grain transport station, from Urumqi to Aksu he established thirty-two stations; the main force of more than fifty thousand required five hundred shi of grain daily; each station was equipped with more than five hundred camels, purchased from Shanxi and Shaanxi;
translations.idiomatic: With Tuoguxun as the first supply depot, he established thirty-two stations from Urumqi to Aksu; the main army of more than fifty thousand required five hundred shi of grain daily; each station was stocked with over five hundred camels purchased from Shanxi and Shaanxi;

sentences.zh: 又蒙古阿拉善部進駝千，烏里雅蘇台調撥官駝四千。

translations.literal: in addition the Alashan Mongols contributed a thousand camels, and Uliastai allocated four thousand government camels.
translations.idiomatic: the Alashan Mongols contributed a thousand camels, and Uliastai allocated four thousand government camels.

sentences.zh: 疏請軍需從寬籌備；

translations.literal: He memorialized requesting that military supplies be generously provisioned;
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that military supplies be generously provisioned;

sentences.zh: 兵丁量增口糧；

translations.literal: soldiers' rations be increased in quantity;
translations.idiomatic: soldiers' rations be increased;

sentences.zh: 給皮衣皮帽，以御寒；

translations.literal: fur coats and fur hats be issued to ward off cold;
translations.idiomatic: fur coats and hats be issued against the cold;

sentences.zh: 出口駝馬芻秣；

translations.literal: fodder be provided for camels and horses on the march;
translations.idiomatic: fodder be provided for camels and horses en route;

sentences.zh: 時給買補缺額營馬，預備續調；

translations.literal: camp horses to fill vacancies be purchased and supplied in timely fashion to prepare for continued deployment;
translations.idiomatic: replacement cavalry horses be purchased promptly to prepare for continued deployment;

sentences.zh: 監造軍械務期堅實；

translations.literal: supervision of military equipment manufacture aim at solidity;
translations.idiomatic: military equipment be manufactured under strict supervision for durability;

sentences.zh: 撥運陝省制錢，平市價；

translations.literal: Shaanxi standard cash be allocated and transported to stabilize market prices;
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi minted cash be transported to stabilize market prices;

sentences.zh: 添設台站夫馬；

translations.literal: courier station laborers and horses be added;
translations.idiomatic: courier station personnel and horses be added;

sentences.zh: 僱用車輛，定例價；

translations.literal: hired vehicles have fixed standard prices;
translations.idiomatic: hired vehicles be subject to fixed standard rates;

sentences.zh: 招募護台民丁；

translations.literal: civilian guards for supply depots be recruited;
translations.idiomatic: civilian guards for supply depots be recruited;

sentences.zh: 後路糧台亦添兵守護：凡十一事，並如議行。

translations.literal: rear-route grain depots also have added troops for protection: all eleven items were implemented as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: rear-route grain depots also receive added military guards: all eleven proposals were approved and implemented.

sentences.zh: 回疆平，加太子少保。

translations.literal: When the Muslim borderlands were pacified he was given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: When the Muslim borderlands were pacified he was granted the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 及張格爾就擒，賜頭品頂戴。

translations.literal: When Zhang Ge'er was captured he was granted the first-rank official hat button.
translations.idiomatic: When Jahangir Khoja was captured he was awarded the first-rank official hat insignia.

sentences.zh: 服闋，授山東巡撫，調山西。

translations.literal: After the mourning period ended he was appointed governor of Shandong and transferred to Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: After his mourning period ended he was appointed governor of Shandong and then transferred to Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 八年，裁撤肅州軍局。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the Suzhou military supply bureau was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 1828 the Suzhou military supply bureau was abolished.

sentences.zh: 始抵任，尋調廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: He had only just assumed his post when he was soon transferred to governor of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He had barely assumed his post when he was transferred to governor of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 十年，又調江蘇，未至，擢湖廣總督。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was again transferred to Jiangsu but did not arrive and was promoted to governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1830 he was transferred to Jiangsu but was promoted to governor-general of Huguang before taking up the post.

sentences.zh: 兩湖鹺務，狃於封輪之例，道光初議散輪，七年復因加價，仍改封輪，引滯商疲。

translations.literal: The salt administration of the Two Hu had been accustomed to the sealed-transport quota system; at the beginning of Daoguang open transport was discussed, but in the seventh year because of price increases it reverted to sealed transport, causing stagnation and merchant exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: The salt administration of the Two Hu provinces clung to the sealed-transport quota system; early in the Daoguang reign open transport was debated, but in 1827 price increases led to a return to sealed quotas, causing stagnation and merchant distress.

sentences.zh: 坤至，疏請實行散輪，建鹽倉於漢岸，俾商船源源攬運。

translations.literal: When Kun arrived he memorialized requesting implementation of open transport, building salt warehouses on the Han River bank so merchant boats could continuously take on loads for transport.
translations.idiomatic: When Lu arrived he memorialized to implement open transport, building salt warehouses on the Han River bank so merchant vessels could continuously take on shipments.

sentences.zh: 尋量減售價，以銷楚岸積鹽。

translations.literal: Soon he reduced selling prices by measure to dispose of accumulated salt on the Chu River bank.
translations.idiomatic: He then reduced selling prices to clear accumulated salt stocks along the Chu River.

sentences.zh: 設塘角總卡，按船編號，以杜內私外私之弊。

translations.literal: He established a main checkpoint at Tangjiao, numbering boats by registration, to stop the abuses of internal and external smuggling.
translations.idiomatic: He established a main checkpoint at Tangjiao with numbered boat registration to curb both official and private smuggling.

sentences.zh: 复湖南永興粵鹽定額，以保淮綱。

translations.literal: He restored the fixed quota for Guangdong salt at Yongxing in Hunan to protect the Huai salt monopoly.
translations.idiomatic: He restored the fixed quota for Guangdong salt at Yongxing in Hunan to protect the Huai salt monopoly region.

sentences.zh: 湖北水災，請免米稅，借帑十萬兩，購川米平糶。

translations.literal: Hubei suffered flood disaster; he requested exemption of rice tax, borrowed a hundred thousand taels from the treasury, and purchased Sichuan rice for sale at fair price.
translations.idiomatic: When Hubei was struck by floods he petitioned for exemption of rice taxes, borrowed a hundred thousand taels from the treasury, and purchased Sichuan rice for sale at fair prices.

sentences.zh: 疏調前兩淮鹽運使王鳳生綜理水利，擇要疏濬河道，修築堤堰，皆以次舉行。

translations.literal: He memorialized to transfer the former Liang-Huai salt transport commissioner Wang Fengsheng to oversee water conservancy comprehensively; selecting key points he dredged rivers, built dikes and weirs, and all were carried out in order.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to appoint the former Liang-Huai salt transport commissioner Wang Fengsheng to oversee water conservancy; key waterways were dredged and dikes built in sequence.

sentences.zh: 十二年，湖南江華瑤趙金龍作亂，粵瑤應之，湖南提督海凌阿及副將、游擊等皆戰歿，坤親往督師，密陳湖北提督羅思舉能辦賊。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the Yao Zhao Jinlong of Jianghua in Hunan rebelled, and the Yao of Guangdong responded; the Hunan provincial commander Hailing'a and brigade generals, colonels, and others all died in battle; Kun went in person to supervise the army and secretly reported that the Hubei provincial commander Luo Siju was capable of handling the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In 1832 the Yao leader Zhao Jinlong of Jianghua in Hunan rebelled, and Yao in Guangdong rose in support; the Hunan provincial commander Hailing'a and several subordinate officers were killed in battle; Lu went in person to take command and privately recommended the Hubei provincial commander Luo Siju as capable of suppressing the rebels.

sentences.zh: 時桂陽、常德諸瑤蜂起應賊，常德水師、荊州駐防兵皆不習山戰，坤至，悉罷之，改調鎮筸苗疆兵，分屯要隘，堅壁清野，與賊相持。

translations.literal: At the time the Yao of Guiyang, Changde, and other places rose in swarms to join the rebels; the Changde naval force and the Jingzhou garrison troops were all unskilled in mountain warfare; when Kun arrived he dismissed them all, transferred instead the Miao borderland troops of Zhenqian, stationed them at strategic passes, practiced fortified defense and scorched-earth tactics, and held the rebels at bay.
translations.idiomatic: Yao in Guiyang, Changde, and elsewhere rose in support of the rebels; the Changde naval force and Jingzhou garrison were unskilled in mountain warfare; Lu dismissed them all, deployed the Miao borderland troops of Zhenqian at strategic passes, adopted fortified defense and scorched-earth tactics, and held the rebels at bay.

sentences.zh: 俟兩湖兵大集，貴州提督餘步雲、雲南副將曾勝亦率軍至，乘雷雨襲擊洋泉街。

translations.literal: When the armies of the Two Hu had massed, the Guizhou provincial commander Yu Buyun and the Yunnan deputy commander Ceng Sheng also led their armies there; taking advantage of thunder and rain they attacked Yangquan Street.
translations.idiomatic: Once the armies of the Two Hu had assembled, the Guizhou provincial commander Yu Buyun and the Yunnan deputy commander Ceng Sheng arrived with their forces and launched a surprise attack on Yangquan Street during a thunderstorm.

sentences.zh: 羅思舉督諸將晝夜環攻，斃賊數千，破其巢，擒金龍子女及頭目數百人。

translations.literal: Luo Siju supervised the generals in day-and-night encirclement attacks, killed several thousand rebels, destroyed their lair, and captured Jinlong's children and several hundred chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Siju directed the generals in round-the-clock assaults, killed several thousand rebels, destroyed their stronghold, and captured Jinlong's family and several hundred rebel leaders.

sentences.zh: 金龍乘間逸，為亂軍所殲，獲其屍及劍印木偶諸物。

translations.literal: Jinlong slipped away in an interval but was destroyed by the disorderly troops; his corpse and sword, seal, wooden idols, and other objects were captured.
translations.idiomatic: Jinlong escaped in the confusion but was killed in the fighting; his body was recovered along with his sword, seal, ritual idols, and other items.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，賜雙眼花翎，世襲一等輕車都尉。

translations.literal: When news of victory arrived he was granted double-eyed peacock feathers and hereditary rank as first-class commandant of light chariots.
translations.idiomatic: On news of victory he was awarded double-eyed peacock feathers and a hereditary rank as first-class commandant of light chariots.

sentences.zh: 尚書禧恩、將軍瑚松額方奉命視師，未至，賊已平。

translations.literal: The minister Xien and General Husonge had just been ordered to inspect the army but had not yet arrived when the rebels were already pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Xien and General Husonge had been ordered to take command of the campaign but had not yet arrived when the rebels were already suppressed.

sentences.zh: 粵瑤趙青仔糾眾數千入楚界，聲言為金龍復仇，連敗之於濠江、銀江，擒青仔磔於市。

translations.literal: The Guangdong Yao Zhao Qingzai mustered several thousand men to enter Chu territory, claiming to avenge Jinlong; they were repeatedly defeated at Haojiang and Yinjiang; Qingzai was captured and dismembered in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangdong Yao leader Zhao Qingzai rallied several thousand followers to cross into Hunan, claiming to avenge Jinlong; Lu defeated them repeatedly at Haojiang and Yinjiang, captured Qingzai, and had him executed by dismemberment in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 廣東連山黃瓜寨瑤猶猖獗，兩廣總督李鴻賓剿治不力，以罪逮，調坤代之。

translations.literal: The Yao of Huangguazhai in Lianshan, Guangdong, were still rampant; the governor-general of the Two Guang Li Hongbin had suppressed them ineffectively and was arrested on criminal charges; Kun was transferred to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: The Yao of Huangguazhai in Lianshan, Guangdong, remained defiant; Governor-General Li Hongbin had failed to suppress them and was arrested; Lu was transferred to replace him.

sentences.zh: 偕禧恩等先後往督諸將進剿，瑤疆悉平。

translations.literal: Together with Xien and others he went in succession to supervise the generals in advancing suppression, and the Yao borderlands were entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Xien and others he supervised the generals in the campaign until the Yao borderlands were fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 合疏陳兩省善後事宜，改移文武官制駐所，並允行。

translations.literal: In a joint memorial they set forth post-pacification measures for the two provinces, revised the stations of civil and military officials, and all were approved for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: In a joint memorial they outlined post-pacification measures for both provinces, revised the placement of civil and military officials, and all proposals were approved.

sentences.zh: 十三年，越南盜陳加海結邊地遊民嘯聚狗頭山，潛入內洋，遣水師擊沉八船，擒加海誅之。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the Vietnamese pirate Chen Jiahai gathered borderland drifters in a rally at Goutou Mountain, secretly entered inner waters; he dispatched the naval force to sink eight ships, captured Jiahai, and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: In 1833 the Vietnamese pirate Chen Jiahai rallied borderland drifters at Goutou Mountain and infiltrated Chinese coastal waters; Lu dispatched the navy to sink eight of his ships, captured Chen, and executed him.

sentences.zh: 尋越南內訌，慎固邊防，拒其請兵，詔嘉得大體。

translations.literal: Soon Vietnam had internal strife; he cautiously strengthened border defenses and refused their request for troops; an edict praised him for grasping the larger principle.
translations.idiomatic: When Vietnam fell into civil strife, he cautiously reinforced border defenses and refused their request for military aid; the emperor commended him for acting with proper statesmanship.

sentences.zh: 英吉利兵船擅入海口，要乞推廣通商，坤依故事停其貿易。

translations.literal: English warships arbitrarily entered the estuary and demanded expanded trade; Kun according to precedent suspended their commerce.
translations.idiomatic: British warships entered the estuary without authorization and demanded expanded trade; Lu suspended their commerce in accordance with established precedent.

sentences.zh: 領事律勞卑挾二船入虎門，砲擊不退，且以砲拒，進泊黃埔。

translations.literal: The consul Napier brought two ships into Humen; cannon fire would not drive them back, and they returned fire with cannon, advancing to anchor at Whampoa.
translations.idiomatic: Consul Napier brought two ships into Humen; cannon fire failed to drive them back, and they returned fire before proceeding to anchor at Whampoa.

sentences.zh: 坤設方略扼其歸路，斷其接濟，集水陸師臨以兵威，律勞卑窮蹙，引罪求去。

translations.literal: Kun devised a strategy to block their return route and cut off their supplies, assembled land and naval forces to confront them with military might; Napier was cornered and confessed guilt, begging to leave.
translations.idiomatic: Lu devised a strategy to block their escape route and cut off their supplies, assembled land and naval forces to confront them with military force; cornered, Napier confessed fault and begged to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 澳門洋商代請命，坤持之良久，乃驅之出口。

translations.literal: Macao foreign merchants pleaded on their behalf; Kun held firm for a long time before finally driving them out of the port.
translations.idiomatic: Macao foreign merchants interceded on their behalf; Lu held firm for a considerable time before finally expelling them from the port.

sentences.zh: 疏聞，詔嘉獎，先奪宮銜、花翎並復之。

translations.literal: When the memorial was reported an edict commended and rewarded him; his court rank and peacock feather had first been stripped and then restored.
translations.idiomatic: When his memorial reached the throne, the emperor commended him; his court rank and peacock feather insignia, briefly stripped, were then restored.

sentences.zh: 於是嚴海防，勤訓練，自南山至大虎分三段，與沙角、大角相聯絡。

translations.literal: Thereupon he tightened coastal defense and diligent training; from Nanshan to Dahu he divided into three sections linked with Shakou and Dajiao.
translations.idiomatic: He then tightened coastal defenses and training; from Nanshan to Dahu he organized three defensive sectors linked with Shakou and Dajiao.

sentences.zh: 省河中流沙地增建砲台，以資保障，夷情斂懾。

translations.literal: On sandy shoals in the provincial river he added batteries for protection, and foreign attitudes became restrained in awe.
translations.idiomatic: He built additional batteries on sandy shoals in the provincial river for protection, and foreign powers became subdued.

sentences.zh: 坤久任封圻，所皆有名績，宣宗深倚之。

translations.literal: Kun long served in border regions and everywhere achieved renowned accomplishments; the Xuanzong Emperor deeply relied on him.
translations.idiomatic: Lu served long in frontier posts and everywhere achieved distinguished results; the Daoguang Emperor relied on him deeply.

sentences.zh: 十五年，卒，贈太子太師、兵部尚書，從優恤，諡文肅。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he died; posthumously conferred Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Minister of War, granted preferential condolence payments, posthumous title Wensu.
translations.idiomatic: In 1835 he died; posthumously conferred Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and Minister of War, granted preferential funeral honors, and given the posthumous name Wensu.

sentences.zh: 子端黼，襲世職。

translations.literal: His son Duanshu inherited the hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: His son Duanshu inherited the hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 曾勝，廣西馬平人。

translations.literal: Ceng Sheng was a man of Maping in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Ceng Sheng came from Maping in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 以行伍從剿湖南苗匪、川、楚教匪，積功至都司。

translations.literal: From the ranks he followed in suppressing the Miao bandits of Hunan and the sect rebels of Sichuan and Hubei, accumulating merit to reach colonel.
translations.idiomatic: Rising through the ranks, he fought in the suppression of Miao rebels in Hunan and sectarian rebels in Sichuan and Hubei, accumulating merit until he reached the rank of colonel.

sentences.zh: 累遷雲南參將，以計擒梟渠徐黑二及宣威小梁山匪首，為時稱。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Yunnan brigade commander; by stratagem he captured the ringleader Xu Heier and the bandit chiefs of Xiaoliangshan in Xuanwei, winning contemporary praise.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to brigade commander in Yunnan; by stratagem he captured the ringleader Xu Heier and bandit chiefs of Xiaoliangshan in Xuanwei, winning widespread acclaim.

sentences.zh: 遷維西協副將。

translations.literal: He was transferred to deputy commander of the Weixi garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to deputy commander of the Weixi garrison.

sentences.zh: 瑤匪趙金龍之亂，率師會剿，擢湖南永州鎮總兵，殲金龍，及擒粵瑤趙青仔，戰皆力。

translations.literal: In the Yao rebel Zhao Jinlong's disorder he led troops in joint suppression, was promoted to commander of Yongzhou garrison in Hunan, destroyed Jinlong, and also captured the Guangdong Yao Zhao Qingzai; in battle he was always vigorous.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yao rebellion led by Zhao Jinlong he led troops in the joint campaign, was promoted to commander of the Yongzhou garrison in Hunan, destroyed Jinlong, and captured the Guangdong Yao leader Zhao Qingzai, distinguishing himself in every battle.

sentences.zh: 尋赴廣東剿連山瑤，迭戰大拱橋、分水嶺、砲台山、火燒坪、軍僚裡、大厓衝、上坻園。

translations.literal: Soon he went to Guangdong to suppress the Lianshan Yao, fighting repeatedly at Dagong Bridge, Fengshui Ridge, Paotai Mountain, Huoshao Flat, Junliaoli, Dayachong, and Shangdiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He then went to Guangdong to suppress the Lianshan Yao, fighting successive engagements at Dagong Bridge, Fengshui Ridge, Paotai Mountain, Huoshao Flat, Junliaoli, Dayachong, and Shangdiyuan.

sentences.zh: 瑤平，論功最，加提督銜，賜號瑚爾察圖巴圖魯，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: When the Yao were pacified his merit was judged greatest; he was given the provincial commander's rank, granted the title Hurcatu Baturu, and awarded hereditary rank as commandant of cloud cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yao were pacified his merit was judged the greatest; he was given provincial commander rank, granted the title Hurcatu Baturu, and awarded a hereditary commandant of cloud cavalry rank.

sentences.zh: 調南韶連鎮，擢廣東陸路提督。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Nanshao-Lian garrison and promoted to Guangdong provincial infantry commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Nanshao-Lian garrison and promoted to provincial infantry commander of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 當英吉利兵船入內河，水師提督李增堦不能阻，勝獻策，以巨船載石沉塞海口老洲岡隘道，聚草船數百橫內河，備火攻，勝率兵臨之，英領事律勞卑悚懼聽令，事乃定。

translations.literal: When English warships entered the inner river the naval commander Li Zengjie could not block them; Sheng offered a plan: use large ships loaded with stone to sink and block the narrow passage at Laozhougang in the estuary, gather several hundred straw boats across the inner river prepared for fire attack; Sheng led troops to confront them; the English consul Napier was fearful and obeyed orders, and the matter was settled.
translations.idiomatic: When British warships entered the inner river, naval commander Li Zengjie could not stop them; Ceng proposed loading large ships with stones to block the narrow passage at Laozhougang, assembling hundreds of straw boats across the river for a fire attack; leading troops to confront them, he forced Consul Napier into submission and resolved the crisis.

sentences.zh: 十七年，卒於官，諡勤勇。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he died in office; posthumous title Qinyong.
translations.idiomatic: In 1837 he died in office; posthumous name Qinyong.

sentences.zh: 陶澍，字云汀，湖南安化人。

translations.literal: Tao Shu, style name Yunting, was a man of Anhua in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Shu, whose courtesy name was Yunting, came from Anhua in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶七年進士，選庶吉士，授編修，遷御史、給事中。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of the Jiaqing reign he passed the metropolitan examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, appointed compiler, and transferred to censor and supervising secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In 1802 he passed the jinshi examination, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, was appointed compiler, and was promoted to censor and supervising secretary.

sentences.zh: 疏劾吏部重簽，河工冒濫，及外省吏治積弊。

translations.literal: He memorialized impeaching the Ministry of Personnel for duplicate signatures, river works for fraudulent excess, and accumulated abuses in provincial governance.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized against duplicate signatures in the Ministry of Personnel, fraud in river works, and accumulated abuses in provincial governance.

sentences.zh: 巡中城，決滯獄八百有奇。

translations.literal: Inspecting the central city he resolved more than eight hundred backlogged cases.
translations.idiomatic: While inspecting the central city he cleared more than eight hundred backlogged cases.

sentences.zh: 巡南漕，革陋規，請濬京口運河。

translations.literal: Inspecting the southern grain transport he abolished corrupt practices and requested dredging of the Jingkou transport canal.
translations.idiomatic: While inspecting southern grain transport he abolished corrupt practices and petitioned to dredge the Jingkou transport canal.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，出為川東道，日坐堂皇，剖決獄訟如流。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he went out as intendant of the eastern Sichuan circuit, daily sitting in the main hall and adjudicating lawsuits like flowing water.
translations.idiomatic: In 1819 he was appointed intendant of the eastern Sichuan circuit, holding court daily and disposing of cases with remarkable efficiency.

sentences.zh: 請減鹽價，私絕課增。

translations.literal: He requested reduction of salt prices and privately ended illicit tax increases.
translations.idiomatic: He petitioned to reduce salt prices and privately ended illicit tax increases.

sentences.zh: 總督蔣攸銛薦其治行為四川第一。

translations.literal: Governor-General Jiang Yihuai recommended his administrative conduct as first in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Jiang Yihuai ranked his governance the finest in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 歷山西按察使、安徽布政使。

translations.literal: He served successively as judicial commissioner of Shanxi and provincial treasurer of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as judicial commissioner of Shanxi and provincial treasurer of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 道光三年，就擢巡撫。

translations.literal: In the third year of the Daoguang reign he was directly promoted to governor.
translations.idiomatic: In 1823 he was promoted directly to governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 安徽庫款，五次清查，未得要領。

translations.literal: Anhui treasury funds had been audited five times without grasping the essentials.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui's treasury accounts had been audited five times without reaching a clear resolution.

sentences.zh: 澍自為籓司時，鉤覈檔案，分別應劾、應償、應豁，於是三十餘年之糾轕，豁然一清。

translations.literal: When Shu was provincial treasurer he audited archives, distinguishing what should be impeached, compensated, or remitted; thus more than thirty years of entanglements were suddenly cleared.
translations.idiomatic: As provincial treasurer he audited the archives, distinguishing cases requiring impeachment, compensation, or remission, and cleared more than thirty years of accumulated entanglements at a stroke.

sentences.zh: 嚴交代，禁流攤，裁捐款，至是奏定章程，俾有司釋累，得專力治民。

translations.literal: He strictly enforced handover of accounts, prohibited itinerant levies, cut donation assessments; at this point he memorialized to fix regulations so officials could be relieved of burdens and devote themselves to governing the people.
translations.idiomatic: He strictly enforced account handovers, banned itinerant levies, and cut donation assessments; he then memorialized fixed regulations so officials could be freed of burdens and focus on governing the people.

sentences.zh: 瀕江水災，購米十萬石，勸捐數十萬金，賑務覈實，災民賴之無失所。

translations.literal: Along the river there was flood disaster; he purchased a hundred thousand shi of rice, urged donations of several hundred thousand taels; relief work was verified as real, and disaster victims relied on it without losing their homes.
translations.idiomatic: When floods struck along the Yangtze he purchased a hundred thousand shi of rice and raised several hundred thousand taels in donations; relief was administered scrupulously, and disaster victims were spared displacement.

sentences.zh: 治壽州城西湖、鳳臺蕉岡湖、鳳陽花源湖；

translations.literal: He managed the West Lake at Shouzhou city, Jiaogang Lake at Fengtai, and Huayuan Lake at Fengyang;
translations.idiomatic: He managed the West Lake at Shouzhou, Jiaogang Lake at Fengtai, and Huayuan Lake at Fengyang;

sentences.zh: 又懷遠新漲沙洲阻水，並開引河，導之入淮。

translations.literal: also at Huaiyuan newly risen sandbars blocked the water, and he opened diversion channels to guide it into the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: and at Huaiyuan, where newly formed sandbars blocked the water, he opened diversion channels to direct flow into the Huai River.

sentences.zh: 淮水所經，勸民修隄束水，保障農田。

translations.literal: Where the Huai River passed he urged the people to repair dikes to contain water and protect farmland.
translations.idiomatic: Along the Huai River he urged the people to repair dikes to contain the waters and protect farmland.

sentences.zh: 各縣設豐備倉於鄉村，令民秋收後量力分捐，不經吏役，不減糶，不出易，不假貸，歲歉備賑，樂歲再捐，略如社倉法而去其弊。

translations.literal: Each county established abundance-reserve granaries in villages, ordering the people after autumn harvest to contribute according to capacity without going through clerks, without reducing sale prices, without trading out, without lending; in lean years they prepared for relief, in good years they contributed again—roughly like the community granary method but removing its abuses.
translations.idiomatic: Each county established village granaries where farmers contributed after harvest according to their means, without clerk involvement, trading, or lending; grain was reserved for lean years and replenished in good years—following the community granary model but eliminating its abuses.

sentences.zh: 創輯安徽通志，旌表忠孝節烈以勵風俗。

translations.literal: He initiated compilation of the Anhui provincial gazetteer and bestowed commendatory tablets on the loyal, filial, and chaste to encourage custom.
translations.idiomatic: He initiated compilation of the Anhui provincial gazetteer and honored the loyal, filial, and chaste with commemorative tablets to uplift public morals.

sentences.zh: 五年，調江蘇。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: In 1825 he was transferred to Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 先是洪澤湖決，漕運梗阻，協辦大學士英和陳海運策，而中外紛議撓之。

translations.literal: Earlier the Hongze Lake had burst its banks and grain transport was obstructed; Grand Secretary Yinghe assisted in proposing a sea transport plan, but inside and outside court contentious debate thwarted it.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the Hongze Lake burst its banks and blocked grain transport, Grand Secretary Yinghe proposed sea transport, but contentious debate inside and outside court thwarted the plan.

sentences.zh: 澍毅然以身任，奏請蘇、松、常、鎮、太五府州漕糧百六十餘萬石歸海運，親赴上海，籌僱商船，體恤商艱，群情踴躍。

translations.literal: Shu resolutely took personal responsibility, memorializing that the grain tribute of more than 1.6 million shi from the five prefectures and departments of Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, Zhenjiang, and Taicang be assigned to sea transport; he went in person to Shanghai, arranged hiring of merchant ships, was considerate of merchants' hardships, and popular sentiment was enthusiastic.
translations.idiomatic: Tao resolutely took personal responsibility, memorializing that the 1.6 million shi of grain tribute from Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, Zhenjiang, and Taicang be shipped by sea; he went to Shanghai in person, arranged merchant shipping with consideration for merchants' difficulties, and won widespread enthusiasm.

sentences.zh: 六年春，開兌，至夏全抵天津，無一漂損者，驗米色率瑩潔，過河運數倍。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixth year transport began; by summer all reached Tianjin without a single loss from flooding; inspection of rice color was on average lustrous and clean, several times better than canal transport.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of 1826 shipping began; by summer all grain reached Tianjin without loss; inspection showed the rice exceptionally clean and bright—several times better than canal transport.

sentences.zh: 商船回空，載豆而南，兩次得值船餘耗米十餘萬石，發部帑收買，由漕項協濟天津、通倉之用，及調劑旗丁，尚節省銀米各十餘萬。

translations.literal: Merchant ships returning empty carried beans southward; twice they obtained more than a hundred thousand shi of surplus transport rice; imperial treasury funds were issued to purchase it, using grain transport funds to assist Tianjin and Tongzhou granary needs and to adjust banner soldiers' rations, still saving more than a hundred thousand each in silver and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Returning merchant ships carried beans southward; twice they yielded more than a hundred thousand shi of surplus transport rice, purchased with imperial funds and applied to Tianjin and Tongzhou granaries and banner soldiers' rations, while still saving more than a hundred thousand taels of silver and shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 事竣，優詔褒美，賜花翎。

translations.literal: When the affair was concluded an edict graciously praised and commended him and granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: When the project concluded the emperor graciously commended him and awarded the peacock feather insignia.

sentences.zh: 明年，遂偕總督蔣攸銛合疏陳海運章程八條，冀垂令甲，永紓漕累，格於部議，未果行。

translations.literal: The next year he joined Governor-General Jiang Yihuai in a joint memorial setting forth eight articles of sea transport regulations, hoping they would become permanent statutes to forever relieve the burden of canal transport; blocked by ministry deliberation, they were not implemented.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he and Governor-General Jiang Yihuai jointly memorialized eight regulations for sea transport, hoping to make them permanent policy and permanently relieve canal transport burdens; blocked by ministry deliberation, the proposal was not adopted.

sentences.zh: 又以紳衿包完漕米，橫索陋規，為漕務之害，奏請懲辦。

translations.literal: He also noted that gentry and degree-holders who contracted to complete grain tribute extorted corrupt practices, a harm to grain transport affairs, and memorialized requesting punishment.
translations.idiomatic: He also identified gentry contractors who completed grain tribute quotas while extorting corrupt fees as a major harm to transport administration and memorialized for their punishment.

sentences.zh: 學政辛從益意不合，爭之。

translations.literal: The education commissioner Xin Congyi disagreed in principle and disputed it.
translations.idiomatic: Education Commissioner Xin Congyi disagreed and contested the proposal.

sentences.zh: 澍复疏言：「陋規日增，勢必取償小民。

translations.literal: Shu again memorialized stating: "Corrupt practices increase daily and will surely be recovered from the common people."
translations.idiomatic: Tao memorialized again: "Corrupt practices grow daily and will inevitably be recovered from the common people."

sentences.zh: 若預計有司不減浮收，置陋規於不問，非釜底抽薪之計。

translations.literal: If one presumes officials will not reduce excessive collection and leaves corrupt practices unaddressed, this is not a plan to remove the fire from beneath the cauldron.
translations.idiomatic: If we assume officials will not reduce excessive levies and leave corrupt practices unaddressed, that is not a fundamental remedy.

sentences.zh: 」仍執前議，治包抗從嚴焉。

translations.literal: He still held to his previous proposal and punished those who contracted and resisted strictly.
translations.idiomatic: He held to his previous proposal and strictly punished gentry contractors who resisted.

sentences.zh: 江蘇頻遭水患，由太湖水洩不暢。

translations.literal: Jiangsu frequently suffered flood disasters because Tai Lake water could not drain freely.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu suffered frequent floods because Tai Lake could not drain freely.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「太湖尾閭在吳淞江及劉河、白茆河，而以吳淞江為最要。

translations.literal: He memorialized stating: "Tai Lake's tail outlets are at the Wusong River and the Liu River and Baichao River, and the Wusong River is the most important."
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized: "Tai Lake drains through the Wusong River, the Liu River, and the Baichao River, and the Wusong River is the most critical."

sentences.zh: 治吳淞以通海口為最要。

translations.literal: Managing the Wusong to open passage to the sea estuary is the most important.
translations.idiomatic: Managing the Wusong to open passage to the sea is the most critical task.

sentences.zh: 」於是以海運節省銀二十餘萬興工，擇賢任事，至八年工竣。

translations.literal: Thereupon using more than two hundred thousand taels saved from sea transport he launched the project, selected worthy men to undertake the work, and by the eighth year the project was completed.
translations.idiomatic: He then allocated more than two hundred thousand taels saved from sea transport, appointed capable men to the project, and completed the work by 1828.

sentences.zh: 又以江以南運道，徒陽運河最易淤阻，而練湖為其上游，孟瀆為其旁支。

translations.literal: He also noted that south of the river the transport route—the Tuyang transport canal—was most easily silted and blocked, while Lian Lake was its upstream and Mengdu its branch channel.
translations.idiomatic: He also noted that south of the Yangtze the Tuyang transport canal was most prone to silting, with Lian Lake as its upstream source and Mengdu as a branch channel.

sentences.zh: 澍自巡漕時，條奏利害，至是先濬徒陽河，將以次舉劉河、白茆、練湖、孟瀆諸工。

translations.literal: Shu from the time he inspected grain transport had submitted in items the advantages and harms; at this point he first dredged the Tuyang River and was to proceed in order with the Liu River, Baichao, Lian Lake, Mengdu, and other projects.
translations.idiomatic: Tao had outlined the issues while inspecting grain transport; he now dredged the Tuyang River first and planned to proceed with the Liu River, Baichao, Lian Lake, Mengdu, and other projects in sequence.

sentences.zh: 後在總督任，與巡撫林則徐合力悉加疏濬，吳中稱為數十年之利，語詳則徐傳。

translations.literal: Later in his governor-general post, together with Governor Lin Zexu he combined forces to dredge them all thoroughly; Wu region called it a benefit of several decades; details are in Lin Zexu's biography.
translations.idiomatic: Later, as governor-general, he and Governor Lin Zexu jointly dredged all these waterways thoroughly; the Wu region hailed it as a benefit lasting decades; details appear in Lin Zexu's biography.

sentences.zh: 十年，以捕獲戶部私造假照要犯，加太子少保銜，署兩江總督，尋實授。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, for capturing a major criminal in the Ministry of Revenue's private forging of credentials, he was given the additional rank Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, acted as governor-general of the Two Jiang, and soon received substantive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In 1830, for capturing a major forger of Ministry of Revenue credentials, he was granted the rank Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, served as acting governor-general of the Two Jiang, and soon received full appointment.

sentences.zh: 時淮鹽敗壞，商困課絀，岌岌不可終日。

translations.literal: At the time Huai salt administration was ruined, merchants were distressed and tax collection failed; the situation was precarious and could not last a day.
translations.idiomatic: The Huai salt administration was in ruins, merchants were distressed, and tax collection was failing; the situation seemed untenable.

sentences.zh: 澍疏陳積弊，請大刪浮費，以為補救。

translations.literal: Shu memorialized setting forth accumulated abuses and requested large cuts in superfluous expenses as remedy.
translations.idiomatic: Tao memorialized on accumulated abuses and petitioned for large cuts in superfluous expenses as a remedy.

sentences.zh: 議者多主改法課歸場灶，命尚書王鼎、侍郎寶興赴江南查議。

translations.literal: Many deliberators advocated changing the law to assign tax collection to production sites; the emperor ordered Minister Wang Ding and Vice Minister Bao Xing to go to Jiangnan to investigate and deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: Many officials advocated reforming the system to collect taxes at production sites; the emperor dispatched Minister Wang Ding and Vice Minister Bao Xing to Jiangnan to investigate.

sentences.zh: 澍謂除弊即以興利，無事輕改舊制，偕鼎等合疏臚陳利害，條上十五事。

translations.literal: Shu said eliminating abuses is itself promoting profit; there was no need lightly to change the old system; together with Ding and others he submitted a joint memorial comprehensively setting forth advantages and harms, listing fifteen items.
translations.idiomatic: Tao argued that eliminating abuses was itself promoting prosperity and that the old system need not be lightly changed; together with Wang Ding and others he submitted a comprehensive memorial listing fifteen proposals.

sentences.zh: 鼎等復請裁鹽政歸總督管理，報可。

translations.literal: Ding and others again requested abolishing the salt administration and placing it under governor-general management; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ding and others again petitioned to abolish the salt administration and place it under the governor-general; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 澍受事，繳還鹽政養廉五千兩，裁減衙門陋規十六萬兩有奇，凡淮南之窩價，淮北之壩槓，兩淮之岸費，分別減除，歲計數百萬兩，分設內外二庫，正款貯內庫，雜項貯外庫，杜絕挪墊。

translations.literal: Shu took charge, returned the salt administration's integrity allowance of five thousand taels, cut yamen corrupt practices by more than a hundred and sixty thousand taels; all Huainan's nest prices, Huaibei's barrier levies, and the Two Huai's shore fees were reduced separately, totaling several million taels yearly; he established inner and outer treasuries, regular funds in the inner treasury and miscellaneous items in the outer, stopping diversion and padding.
translations.idiomatic: Tao took charge, returned the salt administration's integrity allowance of five thousand taels, and cut yamen corrupt practices by more than 160,000 taels; nest prices in Huainan, barrier levies in Huaibei, and shore fees in the Two Huai were all reduced, saving several million taels annually; he established separate inner and outer treasuries for regular and miscellaneous funds, ending diversion and padding.

sentences.zh: 革總商以除把持，散輪規以免淹滯，禁糧船回空帶蘆鹽，及商船借官行私，令行禁止，弊肅風清。

translations.literal: He abolished chief merchants to remove monopolistic control, open transport quotas to avoid stagnation, prohibited grain boats returning empty carrying reed salt and merchant boats using official status for private trade; orders were enforced and prohibitions observed; abuses were cleared and the atmosphere purified.
translations.idiomatic: He abolished chief merchants to break monopolistic control, opened transport quotas to end stagnation, and banned grain boats from smuggling reed salt on return voyages and merchant boats from using official privileges for private trade; abuses were eliminated and administration purified.

sentences.zh: 淮北尤疲累，先借款官督商運，繼仿山東、浙江票引兼行之法，於海州所屬中正、板浦、臨興三場擇要隘設局給票，註明斤數運地，無票越境以私論。

translations.literal: Huaibei was especially exhausted; first he borrowed funds for government-supervised merchant transport, then imitated Shandong and Zhejiang's combined ticket-and-monopoly method; at the three salterns of Zhongzheng, Banpu, and Linxing under Haizhou he selected strategic passes to set up bureaus issuing tickets noting weight and destination; crossing borders without tickets was treated as smuggling.
translations.idiomatic: Huaibei was especially distressed; he first borrowed funds for government-supervised merchant transport, then adopted Shandong and Zhejiang's combined ticket system; at the salterns of Zhongzheng, Banpu, and Linxing near Haizhou he established bureaus at strategic passes to issue tickets noting weight and destination, treating border crossing without tickets as smuggling.

sentences.zh: 仍留暢銷之岸，江運八州縣、湖運十一州縣，歸商運。

translations.literal: He still retained shores with brisk sales; eight counties and departments of river transport and eleven of lake transport were assigned to merchant transport.
translations.idiomatic: He retained shores with strong sales; eight river-transport counties and eleven lake-transport counties were assigned to merchant shipping.

sentences.zh: 十二年，奏准開辦，越半歲，溢銷逾額，复推廣於江運、湖運各岸，減價裁費，商販爭趨，而窩商蠹吏、壩夫岸胥一旦盡失其中飽需索之利，群議沸騰。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year memorial approval was granted to launch it; within half a year sales exceeded quota; it was again extended to river and lake transport shores; prices and fees were cut; merchants rushed to participate; but nest merchants, corrupt officials, barrier laborers, and shore clerks suddenly lost all their embezzlement and extortion profits, and public debate boiled over.
translations.idiomatic: In 1832 approval was granted; within six months sales exceeded quotas; the system was extended to river and lake transport shores with price and fee reductions; merchants flocked to participate; but nest merchants, corrupt officials, barrier workers, and shore clerks suddenly lost their embezzlement profits, and controversy erupted.

sentences.zh: 言官摭浮言，屢事彈劾，賴宣宗鑑其忠誠，倚畀愈專。

translations.literal: Censorial officials gathered floating rumors and repeatedly impeached him; relying on the Xuanzong Emperor discerning his loyalty, his trust and commission grew ever more exclusive.
translations.idiomatic: Censorial officials seized on rumors and repeatedly impeached him; the Daoguang Emperor recognized his loyalty and relied on him ever more exclusively.

sentences.zh: 屢請復鹽政專職，皆不許，澍益感奮，力排眾議，毅然持之，卒獲成效。

translations.literal: He repeatedly requested restoration of the salt administration's specialized post; all were denied; Shu was increasingly moved to exert himself, forcefully rejecting public debate, resolutely holding to it, and finally achieved results.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly petitioned to restore the dedicated salt administration post but was always refused; increasingly inspired, Tao forcefully rejected opposition, held firm, and ultimately succeeded.

sentences.zh: 道光元年至十年，淮南行六綱，淮北僅行三綱。

translations.literal: From the first to the tenth year of Daoguang, Huainan completed six quota cycles and Huaibei only three.
translations.idiomatic: From 1821 to 1830, Huainan completed six quota cycles while Huaibei completed only three.

sentences.zh: 澍承極弊之後，自十一年至十七年，淮南已完六綱有餘，淮北率一歲行兩綱之鹽，盡完從前滯欠，且割淮南懸引，兩淮共完正雜銀二千六百四十餘萬兩，庫貯實存三百餘萬兩。

translations.literal: Shu inherited after extreme decay; from the eleventh to the seventeenth year Huainan completed six quota cycles with surplus, Huaibei on average completed two cycles' salt per year, fully clearing previous arrears, and also applied Huainan's suspended quotas; the Two Huai together completed regular and miscellaneous silver of more than 26.4 million taels, with actual treasury storage of more than three million taels.
translations.idiomatic: Taking charge after extreme decay, from 1831 to 1837 Tao brought Huainan through six full quota cycles with surplus, Huaibei through two cycles per year, cleared all arrears, and applied Huainan's suspended quotas; the Two Huai together collected more than 26.4 million taels in regular and miscellaneous revenue, with over three million taels in treasury reserves.

sentences.zh: 兩屆京察，並被褒獎優敘。

translations.literal: In two rounds of capital inspection he was both commended and given preferential promotion consideration.
translations.idiomatic: In two capital inspections he received commendation and preferential promotion.

sentences.zh: 晚年將推淮北之法於淮南，已病風痺，未竟其施，然天下皆知票鹽減價敵私，為正本清源之計。

translations.literal: In his later years he was about to extend Huaibei's method to Huainan but was already afflicted with wind paralysis and did not complete the implementation; yet all under heaven knew ticket salt with reduced prices countered smuggling as a plan to rectify the root and clear the source.
translations.idiomatic: In his later years he planned to extend the Huaibei system to Huainan but was stricken with paralysis and could not complete it; yet the world recognized that ticket salt at reduced prices countered smuggling as a fundamental remedy.

sentences.zh: 後咸豐中乃卒行之。

translations.literal: Later in the Xianfeng reign it was finally implemented.
translations.idiomatic: It was finally implemented during the Xianfeng reign.

sentences.zh: 十九年，卒。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In 1839 he died.

sentences.zh: 遺疏上，優詔軫惜，稱其「實心任事，不避嫌怨」，晉贈太子太保，依尚書例賜卹，賜其子桄主事，諡文毅。

translations.literal: His final memorial was submitted; an edict graciously expressed sorrow and praised him as "sincere in service, not avoiding resentment"; he was posthumously promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted condolence payments according to minister precedent, his son Guang was given a secretariat post, posthumous title Wenyi.
translations.idiomatic: His final memorial reached the throne; the emperor expressed sorrow and praised his "sincere dedication without fear of resentment"; he was posthumously promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted funeral honors as a minister, his son Guang received a secretariat post, and he was given the posthumous name Wenyi.

sentences.zh: 祝名宦祠，於海州建專祠。

translations.literal: He was worshipped in the shrine of eminent officials and a dedicated shrine was built for him at Haizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was enshrined in the hall of eminent officials, and a dedicated shrine was built for him at Haizhou.

sentences.zh: 澍見義勇為，胸無城府。

translations.literal: Shu saw righteousness and acted bravely, with no hidden agendas in his breast.
translations.idiomatic: Tao acted boldly for righteousness and was utterly without hidden agendas.

sentences.zh: 用人能盡其長，所拔取多至方面節鉞有名。

translations.literal: In employing men he could fully use their strengths; those he selected and promoted mostly rose to provincial governor rank with renown.
translations.idiomatic: He employed men to their full strengths; many he promoted rose to provincial governor rank with distinction.

sentences.zh: 在江南治河、治漕、治鹽，並賴王鳳生、俞德源、姚瑩、黃冕諸人之力。

translations.literal: In Jiangnan in managing rivers, grain transport, and salt, he all relied on the strength of Wang Fengsheng, Yu Deyuan, Yao Ying, Huang Mian, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiangnan his river, transport, and salt reforms all relied on Wang Fengsheng, Yu Deyuan, Yao Ying, Huang Mian, and others.

sentences.zh: 左宗棠、胡林翼皆識之未遇，結為婚姻，後俱為名臣。

translations.literal: Zuo Zongtang and Hu Linyi both knew him before he rose to prominence and formed marriage alliances; later both became renowned ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang and Hu Linyi both knew him before his rise and formed marriage ties with his family; both later became renowned statesmen.

sentences.zh: 所著奏議、詩文集、蜀輶日記、陶桓公年譜、​​陶淵明詩輯註並行世。

translations.literal: His writings including memorials, collected poetry and prose, Diary of the Sichuan Journey, Chronological Biography of Duke Huan of Tao, and Collected Annotations on Tao Yuanming's Poetry all circulated in the world.
translations.idiomatic: His writings—including memorials, poetry and prose, Diary of the Sichuan Journey, a chronology of Duke Huan of Tao, and annotated poems of Tao Yuanming—all circulated widely.

sentences.zh: 論曰：趙慎畛學有本源，察吏治民，嚴而能恕，所至政無不舉。

translations.literal: The appraisal states: Zhao Shenzhen's learning had genuine roots; in inspecting officials and governing the people he was strict yet forgiving; wherever he went no policy failed to be implemented.
translations.idiomatic: The appraisal states: Zhao Shenzhen's scholarship had deep roots; in evaluating officials and governing the people he was strict yet forgiving; wherever he served, his policies succeeded.

sentences.zh: 盧坤治回疆軍需，平湖南瑤，馭廣東夷商，皆有殊績。

translations.literal: Lu Kun managed Muslim borderland military supplies, pacified the Hunan Yao, and controlled Guangdong foreign merchants—all with outstanding achievements.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Kun managed military supply in the Muslim borderlands, pacified the Hunan Yao, and handled Guangdong's foreign merchants—all with distinguished achievements.

sentences.zh: 陶澍治水利、漕運、鹽政，垂百年之利，為屏為翰，庶無媿焉。

translations.literal: Tao Shu managed water conservancy, grain transport, and salt administration, bestowing benefits lasting a century; as screen and pillar, he may be without shame.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Shu's reforms in water conservancy, grain transport, and salt administration brought benefits lasting a century; as a bulwark and pillar of the state, he had little to be ashamed of.

sentences.zh: 道光中年後，海內多事，諸臣並已徂謝，遂無以紓朝廷南顧之憂。

translations.literal: After the middle years of Daoguang, within the seas many affairs arose; these ministers had all already passed away, and thus there was no one to relieve the court's anxiety in looking south.
translations.idiomatic: After the mid-Daoguang years, turmoil spread across the empire; these ministers had all passed away, and the court had no one left to ease its anxieties about the south.

sentences.zh: 人之雲亡，邦國殄瘁，其信然哉！

translations.literal: When worthy men pass away like clouds, the state is brought to ruin and exhaustion—how true indeed!
translations.idiomatic: When worthy men depart like clouds dispersing, the state falls into ruin—how painfully true!
